specs.title: SCN-001: A signed-in customer adds a favourite

steps.title: Given I am a signed-in customer and know an in-stock product
[SEED] signed-in customer (register + login; customers cannot be deleted)
[SEED] find in-stock products (GET /products/search)
When I POST the product to /favorites
Then the response status is 201
And the favourite has an id and the product id I sent

specs.title: SCN-002: Adding the same favourite twice is rejected with 409

steps.title: Given I am a signed-in customer with the product in my favourites
[SEED] signed-in customer (register + login; customers cannot be deleted)
[SEED] find in-stock products (GET /products/search)
[SEED] favourite Combination Pliers
When I POST the same product to /favorites again
Then the response status is 409
And GET /favorites contains the product once

specs.title: SCN-003: A customer sees only their own favourites

steps.title: Given another customer has a favourite product
[SEED] other customer (register + login; customers cannot be deleted)
[SEED] find in-stock products (GET /products/search)
[SEED] favourite Pliers
And I am a signed-in customer with a different favourite
[SEED] signed-in customer (register + login; customers cannot be deleted)
[SEED] favourite Combination Pliers
When I GET /favorites
Then my favourite is listed
And the other customer's favourite is not

specs.title: SCN-005: Adding a favourite on the web shop

steps.title: Given I am signed in on the web shop as a registered customer
[SEED] signed-in customer (register + login; customers cannot be deleted)
[SEED] sign in on the web shop
And I am on the product page of an in-stock product
When I click "Add to favourites"
Then I see "Product added to your favorites list."
And the product appears on the Favorites page of my account
Given I am a signed-in customer with the product in my favourites
[SEED] signed-in customer (register + login; customers cannot be deleted)
[SEED] favourite Combination Pliers
When I DELETE the favourite
Then the response status is 204
And GET /favorites no longer contains it
